rdfs:label: EmptyCollection
rdfs:comment: A PROV Collection with no members — the explicit empty case.
notes: Useful when you need to assert "this collection is definitively empty" rather than "the membership is unknown". Often the first state of a collection in a build pipeline before items are added; subsequent versions then `prov:wasDerivedFrom` the EmptyCollection. Subclass of `prov:Collection` (not `urn:solid:Collection`, which is `as:Collection`); members via `urn:solid:hadMember`.

history.note: Added notToBeConfusedWith Collection (as:Collection) and prov:Collection note; example @id no longer suggests Bundle.
